scripts.postinstall:default: npm run sync && cp .env.template .env && npm run updates && npm run fonts-build && npm run git-config
scripts.postinstall:windows: npm run sync && copy .env.template .env && npm run updates && npm run fonts-build && npm run git-config
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore "npx vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts" --project=demo-wordplay --log-verbosity QUIET
scripts.end2end: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec "npx playwright test" --project=demo-wordplay --log-verbosity QUIET
scripts.emu: npx tsx scripts/seed.ts & npx tsx scripts/emulate.ts
scripts.build: npm upgrade shared-types && npm run env && npm run updates && npm run how && npm run mediapipe && npm run fonts-build && vite build && (cd functions && npm run build)
scripts.build:ci: npm run env && npm run updates && npm run how && npm run mediapipe && npm run fonts-build && vite build && (cd functions && npm run build)
scripts.build:web: npm run env && npm run updates && npm run how && npm run mediapipe && npm run fonts-build && vite build
scripts.stage: firebase use dev && firebase deploy && npm run env
scripts.release: firebase use prod && firebase deploy && firebase use dev && npm run env
scripts.locale-schema: npx ts-json-schema-generator --no-type-check --tsconfig tsconfig.json --path 'src/locale/LocaleText.ts' --type 'LocaleText' --out static/schemas/LocaleText.json && npx tsx src/util/verify-locales/generate-template-inputs.ts
scripts.create-schemas: npm run tutorial-schema && npm run locale-schema && npm run datetime-schema && npx prettier --write static/schemas
scripts.fonts-build: npx tsx scripts/fonts/start.ts build && npx prettier --write static/fonts/fonts.css static/fonts/fonts-fallback.css src/basis/faces/faces.generated.ts
scripts.fonts-fix: npx tsx scripts/fonts/start.ts fix && npx prettier --write static/fonts/fonts.css static/fonts/fonts-fallback.css src/basis/faces/faces.generated.ts src/basis/faces/faces.fallback.generated.ts src/basis/faces/renderable.generated.ts src/basis/faces/metrics.generated.ts src/basis/faces/fonts.lock.json
scripts.fonts-download: npx tsx scripts/fonts/start.ts download && npx prettier --write static/fonts/fonts.css static/fonts/fonts-fallback.css src/basis/faces/faces.generated.ts src/basis/faces/renderable.generated.ts
scripts.logo-fix: npx tsx scripts/logo/start.ts fix && npx prettier --write scripts/logo/logo.lock.json
scripts.instruments-build: npx tsx scripts/instruments/start.ts build && npx prettier --write src/output/Music/samples.generated.ts scripts/instruments/instruments.lock.json
scripts.merge: git checkout main && git merge dev && git push origin main && git checkout dev
